purpose: Preserve the complete iteration_008 21-family, 49-variant, 10-global simulator baseline and add one generic zero-call operational-boundary-predicate family for iteration_009, yielding 22 families and 56 variants without reclassifying the candidate-V4 predecessor FAIL or authorizing a retained-suite rerun.

simulator_surface.controller_invocation: subprocess public simulate and reopen CLI only
simulator_surface.backend_test_invocation: subprocess backend.py self-test only; no new backend command or private import
simulator_surface.simulator_only_evidence_root: PW_R9_SIMULATOR_EVIDENCE_ROOT names an existing absolute regular nonlink directory; controller run roots remain absent direct children

compact_root.caller_root_rule: Caller supplies one absent safe direct-child suite root; reuse is forbidden.
compact_root.source_strategy: Normal traversals read the controller, backend, verifier, contracts, manifests, and transitive semantic files from immutable iteration_009/SUCCESSOR locations in place and bind them once by path, SHA-256, bytes, Git blob OID, HEAD blob OID, local HEAD, and local origin/main. The bounded check also reopens iteration_008 semantic/catalog/fault baselines and the exact V4 run-01 diagnosis to prove the generic operational-rule delta. The R9-REG-007 selector variant retains the exact archived candidate-V2 rollout, failed terminal, diagnosis, predecessor backend, and backend self-test. The R9-REG-020 historical-HEAD repair is retained unchanged.
compact_root.clean_evidence: evidence/synthetic-clean-001 and evidence/synthetic-clean-002 retain every provider_input.txt, attempt.json, raw_result.json, completion.json, 54 route-local artifacts, three path terminals, matrix terminal, accounting, and run manifest.
compact_root.fault_evidence: fault_evidence retains only compact controller roots needed for direct lifecycle or path-stop observation; faults retains one canonical typed receipt per normalized variant/global case and exact before/after capture bytes for mutation cases.
compact_root.working_roots: work/tmp-* is never final evidence. It may be removed only by exact regular-file unlink and directory rmdir after typed captures are durable. No gio, trash, recursive remove, symlink, or broad deletion is permitted.
compact_root.final_evidence: Never deleted or compacted after simulator_receipt.json is created.

source_bundle.validation: Every semantic_manifest files row is a safe regular nonlink with exact declared SHA-256 and bytes. Top-level iteration controls and the operating contract are also bound.
source_bundle.git: Record exact current Git blob OID and HEAD blob OID for every bound file plus local HEAD, local origin/main, scoped porcelain-v2 bytes, and equality booleans. No fetch or network occurs.
source_bundle.durable_reopen_projection: Compare receipt before, receipt after, and current only as exact sorted path/SHA-256/bytes rows. Mutable historical HEAD, origin/main, porcelain status, tracking state, Git OIDs, and status digests are excluded from historical equality.
source_bundle.current_custody: Report current local HEAD equality with local origin/main and require every recorded bound file to match its current HEAD blob as a separate fail-closed result.
source_bundle.custody_rule: A suite reopen fails unless the retained simulator receipt and every section required by its recorded command are PASS, and also fails for stable path/identity drift, missing or extra recorded paths, current HEAD/origin inequality, or any bound file not matching current HEAD. It does not fail merely because historical HEAD or tracking/status observations differ from current custody. Stabilization exit remains separately unauthorized until external review closes.

causal_requirements.stage_storage: canonical exact expected_artifact plus one LF
causal_requirements.post_fail: The first valid FAIL in a route stops that route before any later attempt; other routes may start their own first row, so uniform synthetic FAIL yields exactly three row chains and zero later same-slot starts.
causal_requirements.controller_invalid: Abort every route with no later attempt or artifact.
causal_requirements.reopen: Controller public reopen invokes the independent verifier, which replays cell gates, stage eligibility, artifact exactness, terminals, bundle binding, freshness, deterministic score, and accounting.

supervised_persistence.admission: A supervisor may signal only after the same regular nonlink path is observed twice consecutively with identical SHA-256 and bytes, exact canonical JSON plus one terminal LF and no CR, and the expected schema_id. The retained bytes must remain identical after process termination.
supervised_persistence.malformed_or_partial: Existence, zero bytes, partial JSON, noncanonical JSON, the wrong schema, or a single canonical observation is not persistence and cannot authorize a signal.
supervised_persistence.phased_writer_reproducer: The loss-after-completion variant create-only phases one local completion witness through empty, canonical JSON without terminal LF, and full canonical one-LF storage. The iteration_004 existence predicate accepts the first two phases; iteration_006 rejects both, then requires two identical full observations and retained-byte identity. It uses zero subject, provider, and network calls.

stage_specific_replacement.deleted_dependency: The supervised_observation strategy never calls the generic _evidence_summary partial-root summarizer.
stage_specific_replacement.hard_loss: SIGKILL requires process rc -9 with no controller result; the canonical witnessed prefix is row-, schema-, and identity-bound; every later stage is typed ABSENT, INCOMPLETE_OR_MALFORMED with raw path/hash/bytes and no valid admission, or CANONICAL_PRE_CRASH. Public reopen must return rc 2 CONTROLLER_INVALID without changing one inventory byte, and no path/matrix/accounting terminal, later row, retry, relaunch, replacement, best-of selection, or credit may exist.
stage_specific_replacement.graceful_drain: SIGTERM requires controller and public reopen rc 2 STOPPED_AFTER_DRAIN, one complete exact row chain, valid offline verification, exact three path terminals plus matrix/accounting terminals, no later row, and byte-identical inventory across reopen.
stage_specific_replacement.expect_enforcement: Every key declared by a supervised scenario expect object is explicitly recognized and compared; unknown fields fail closed.

predecessor.reason: The candidate-V2 selector counted one precontext user response_item plus the exact target-turn prompt and rejected session-wide user cardinality 2.

successor.selection: Exactly one user message strictly after the unique matching turn_context and before the matching task_complete, with one input_text equal to provider_input byte-for-byte.

rollout_selector_reproducer.execution: The simulator invokes only backend.py self-test in a bounded subprocess and binds its rollout_selector causal receipt. The self-test uses local JSONL fixtures and the archived rollout; it does not start app-server or make a provider, subject, model, or network call.

semantic_predicate_repair.predecessor_question: Does this source-supported candidate express an authority, scope, sequence, lineage, or evidence boundary that downstream synthesis must preserve explicitly?
semantic_predicate_repair.successor_question: After applying the supplied predecessor_outputs, does this candidate still leave a durable unresolved authority, scope, sequence, lineage, or evidence boundary that downstream synthesis must preserve explicitly?
semantic_predicate_repair.execution: The public check reopens exact JSON and prompt bytes only. It performs no model, provider, subject, or network call and writes no evidence.

operational_boundary_predicate_repair.predecessor: Exact candidate-V4 four tension renders retain the 211-byte clarified question but lack an operational rule; the static reproducer classifies this FAIL_CONTRACT_INCOMPLETE and preserves the empirical true/false/true route split.
operational_boundary_predicate_repair.successor: Insert the same exact 487-byte operational rule once after the common tension instruction in all four tension renders and zero times in the other 93 renders; the 211-byte question remains byte-identical.
operational_boundary_predicate_repair.execution: The public check reopens exact JSON and prompt bytes only. It performs no model, provider, subject, or network call and writes no retained evidence.

regression_coverage.mapping: Every catalog regression_id and primary stabilized scenario_id appears exactly once. The iteration_008 21 family rows, 49 fault variants, 10 global cases, selector archive/self-test, and every existing fault remain object-identical; R9-REG-022 adds exactly seven generic data-only operational-boundary variants.
regression_coverage.predecessor_rule: Every predecessor receipt is reopened against catalog SHA-256 and bytes and remains typed FAIL.
regression_coverage.current_rule: PASS means only the current zero-provider simulator observed the required behavior or rejection; it never reclassifies predecessor evidence.

historical_head_reproducer.predecessor: iteration_002 public reopen returns CONTROLLER_INVALID with offline verifier RUN_GIT_HEAD_DRIFT after only current HEAD advances
historical_head_reproducer.successor: iteration_009 preserves iteration_008's run-level and suite-level historical-head repair, stage-specific partial-root fault evaluation, backend-local R9-REG-007 selector repair, and R9-REG-021 clarification while adding only R9-REG-022's generic operational rule

same_family_post_push_suite_reproducer.predecessor: FAIL because the suite comparator required pre-push mutable Git/status snapshot equality after bytes became tracked and pushed
same_family_post_push_suite_reproducer.successor: PASS only when stable sorted path/SHA-256/bytes identities, independently reopened inventory, both receipt-bound public clean-run reopens, and separately reported current Git custody all pass

required_faults: ordered stop at a row boundary

retained_inventory.write_order: last after simulator_receipt.json and after work is empty and removed
retained_inventory.coverage: Every retained regular file is listed by relative path, SHA-256, and bytes. inventory.json is the sole explicit cryptographic self-reference exclusion.
retained_inventory.independent_reopen: The simulator immediately reopens the canonical inventory. reopen-suite first requires the retained simulator receipt and the clean_pair plus command-required faults section to be PASS, then repeats the exact retained-file inventory check, compares stable sorted receipt-before/receipt-after/current path/SHA-256/bytes rows, reports current Git custody separately, and invokes the receipt-bound public controller reopen for exactly both clean runs.

suite_receipt.write: create-only canonical JSON plus one LF after all requested work is terminal and before inventory.json

fail_closed: A missing or nonregular controller.py, backend.py, verifier.py, contract, manifest, or semantic source blocks execution.
Any source-bundle change during a clean traversal or suite fails the suite.

A retained suite receipt that is not PASS, has an error, has nonzero calls, changed source bytes, or lacks PASS sections required by its recorded command fails reopen-suite before any clean-run reopen; the exact pushed iteration_004 failed suite remains FAIL.

Any missing or extra stable source path, source byte-identity drift, current HEAD/origin inequality, or bound-file/current-HEAD mismatch fails reopen-suite; historical mutable Git/status equality is never required.
Any controller invocation outside public simulate or reopen is impossible in simulator code and fails static inspection.
Any malformed, partial, noncanonical, wrong-schema, singly observed, or post-observation-mutated durable controller JSON fails the scenario and cannot authorize a supervisor signal.
A malformed next-stage file remains invalid even when the fault scenario correctly observes fail-closed behavior; scenario PASS never reclassifies it as admitted evidence.
Any clean run other than exactly 291 PASS chains, 54 artifacts, three path terminals, matrix terminal, and accounting fails.
Any post-FAIL later same-slot start fails.
Any missing normalized family, variant, required fault label, causal global case, or predecessor identity fails.
Any candidate-V2 archive drift, backend self-test failure, selector case omission, acceptance outside precontext counts 0/1/2, or ambiguous/malformed target-turn fixture admission fails.
Any change to the 21 historical family objects, 49 historical fault variants, 10 global cases, or existing backend selector archive/self-test fails.

Any successor tension prompt retaining the predecessor generic question, omitting the clarified question, changing more or fewer than four prompts, changing any of 93 non-tension prompts, or changing any expected output, dependency gate, route, schedule row, or deterministic artifact fails.

Any B-T02 oracle flip, predecessor FAIL reclassification, operational-rule identity drift, answer leakage, cell/model/route/slot branch, or counterfactual truth other than false/false/false/true/true/true plus leakage PASS fails.
Any retained symlink, nonregular member, pycache, bytecode, un-inventoried file, inventory mismatch, retry, replacement, best-of, or duplicate clean identity fails.
An incomplete suite never writes a PASS receipt.

stabilization_exit.rule: The simulator always reports stabilization exit FAIL/NOT_AUTHORIZED and names remaining pushed-Git custody and independent-review blockers. Suite PASS is subordinate zero-credit evidence only.

nonclaims: Synthetic runs earn zero empirical or qualification credit.
A suite PASS is not stabilization exit, preseal audit, formal candidate, freeze, canary, matrix qualification, production readiness, or release authority.
Static source-binding projections do not claim hostile-code execution or malicious-controller resistance.
The simulator does not claim resistance to a malicious trusted controller, host compromise, arbitrary private callers, callbacks, reflection, or missing capability tokens.
